now.title: Eternals
now.text: Sersi lives in London as a museum teacher until a Deviant attack reunites her with Ikaris and Sprite. Chosen by Ajak, she learns Earth is a Celestial's egg and gathers the Eternals to stop the Emergence.

proposed.text: Sersi lives in London as a museum teacher until a Deviant attack reunites her with Ikaris. Chosen by Ajak, she learns Earth is a Celestial's egg and gathers the Eternals to stop the Emergence.

changes.evidence: Eternals: Sersi and Sprite already live together in London when the Deviant Kro attacks them; the attack reunites Sersi only with Ikaris, who arrives and chases it off. Sprite is not reunited with her.

now.title: Eyes of Wakanda
now.text: In episode 1, the Lion rules Crete like a god and raids for slaves with stolen Wakandan tech.
cases: ST-125 The Fall of the Lion's Kingdom (Eyes of Wakanda)

proposed.text: In episode 1, the Lion rules his own pirate kingdom like a god and raids Crete for captives with stolen Wakandan tech.

changes.evidence: Eyes of Wakanda ep 1 'Into the Lion's Den': Nkati/the Lion is a pirate who founds his own kingdom (a fleet and a deep-sea complex) and declares himself king and god; his fleet RAIDS Minoan Crete and takes survivors captive (Noni lets herself be taken in that raid). He does not rule Crete. (The file's 'kind', 'A rogue Wakandan ruling ancient Crete', has the same error.)

now.title: Avengers: Endgame
now.text: Restored, Groot fights in the final battle.
cases: ST-079 The Battle of Earth (Avengers: Endgame)

changes.evidence: Avengers: Endgame ends with Groot and the Guardians picking up Thor at New Asgard and leaving Earth on the Benatar, so the title leaves him off-world (Peter's and Drax's Endgame records in this chunk already use Off-world).
